description: ProcessManager.stop removes the entry from the Map by default (options.remove !== false). The plan specifies the opposite default: 'No-op if absent or already exited unless remove is true, in which case the Map entry is deleted'. Default-removal silently drops dev-server logs/status history after dev_server.stop, breaking the post-stop status/logs read path the long-lived dev-server design depends on. It also makes dev-server-start.ts's recovery path work only accidentally; the contract is inverted from the plan.
suggestedFix: Flip the default: only delete when options.remove === true. Update dev-server-start.ts failure cleanup to pass { remove: true } explicitly. Update the dev-server.test.ts 'clears a failed startup handle' assertion to reflect the explicit remove flag. Consider keeping a separate cleanup pass in shutdown if log retention after dev_server.stop is desired.
